newsitem.title: USA: Rank Group stays out of Trump's Castle-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Rank Group stays out of Trump's Castle-WSJ.

text.p: Rank Group Plc won't be joining as a partner in the Trump's Castle resort in Atlantic City, leaving Trump Hotels & Casino Resorts Inc in a tough position, the Wall Street Journal reported Monday.

The development is likely to cause concern among Trump Hotels shareholders, some of whom viewed the Rank transaction as a way of justifying the company's recent $490 million acquisition of the property from Trump hotels Chairman Donald J. Trump, the newspaper reported.
For three months Trump Hotels has tried to sell up to 50 percent of Trump's Castle to Rank, a British leisure and entertainment company, the newspaper reported.
